description: NaMgTi₂BiO₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.05 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (1.88 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.84 Å. Bi is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Ti, and one Bi atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMgTiBi tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMgTi₂ tetrahedra.
